info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollment Certificates API allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of certificates associated with education enrollments. This endpoint supports the retrieval of important educational credentials for students or participants. Ideal for educational institutions and administrative systems, it facilitates the management and verification of educational achievements. Users can leverage this API to enhance their reporting, compliance, and administrative functions related to enrollment data.

get.summary: Retrieve a certificate for an enrollment.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a specific certificate associated with an enrollment. By providing the necessary identifiers, users can access relevant certificate information efficiently.

requestBody.description: Retrieve the certificate associated with a specific enrollment. This request requires information pertaining to the enrollment to process the certificate retrieval accurately.
